# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon (8,13,21,34) contracts to a narrow width (<70% of its 20-bar minimum), a breakout in the ribbon's slope direction with above-average volume captures intraday momentum. This exploits volatility contraction expansion patterns where compressed EMAs precede directional moves, distinct from Bollinger Band squeezes by using EMA ribbon width and volume-filtered breakouts.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Long if ribbon width (max EMA - min EMA) < 70% of its lowest value over prior 20 bars AND price closes above highest EMA with volume > 1.5x 5-bar average volume. Symmetrically short below lowest EMA.  
**Exit:** Chart-stop at opposite ribbon side (below lowest EMA for long, above highest EMA for short), TP1 at 2R, runner trail using chandelier exit (ATR×3).  
**Regime:** VIX between 15-25 and time after 10:00 EST.
